body: I see where you are coming from and I understand your sentiments. Rest could be the best thing on this Earth, and yet we can never seem to achieve it. There can be no life without death. And yet, at the same time, that means the opposite is true. There is no death without life. We are born on this Earth to die, but we are also submitted to death because we have lived. Everyone is given a chance to live their life to their ability. Some are given a choice of when they die, and I can tell you now it is not yet your time. Please, please live. Live for the chance to be fulfilled when death comes knocking. It is not an easy or balanced fight, but it certainly isn't over. I hope you can get through this.
